title: Download selected agency monthly summary page as PDF
description: A customer-service user downloads the exact authorized current page selected in the agency monthly report designer as a readable Chinese PDF. Reuse ERP-181 bounded preview and current-user menu and salesperson scope checks on every request; use the existing shared SimHei PDF font resolver and a new narrow exporter, failing clearly when the font is unavailable. Preserve selected column order, original-currency separation, status-specific evidence and an explicit empty-page note; paginate wide and long pages without clipping. OperationLogMiddleware records download access. Development only: no schema/migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets or .env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused PDF tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: POST PDF export reuses the ERP-181 authorized bounded current page; revoked access and invalid fields or filters fail closed before source reads.
PDF uses shared Chinese font resolution, paginates wide columns and long row sets, preserves original currencies and status-specific values, and has explicit empty-page and font-missing behavior.

Designer offers PDF download for current filters and page; focused PDF tests cover denied access, mixed currencies, selected columns, page breaks, empty page and missing font, and safe Release build/test passes.
